messages:
OncallBot: :rotating_light: PAGED: billing-metering anomaly detected on aggregator-eu-2. token_count_delta > 15% over 5m across several partitions. runbook: https://runbooks.example/realtime-metering
Priya: I'm oncall — looking. Moving to incident channel #incidents. tagging @Jordan and @Alex for SRE/billing help.
Jordan: on my way. can you grab recent emitter logs and a diff of kafka offsets? run: 
```kubectl -n billing logs deploy/token-emitter -c main --since=10m | tail -n 200
kubectl -n billing exec -it token-agg-0 -- /bin/sh -c "./offsets.sh --topic usage"```
Priya: ran logs, pasting relevant lines: 
```WARN emitter: duplicate event detected producer_id=svc-proxy-7 count=3
INFO aggregator: ingest 2026-03-18T09:12:34 shard=12 tokens=1245
INFO aggregator: ingest 2026-03-18T09:12:35 shard=12 tokens=2489 (possible duplicate)
```
Alex: billing-eng chiming in — looks like the proxy retried a batch and producer_id persisted, so emitter didn't dedupe. dedupe flag was accidentally off after the 02:00 deploy. Suggest: enable dedupe=true in emitter config and throttle ingress for 10m.
Maya: FinanceOps — customer visible: two orgs got +30% spike in dashboard and one received an overage alert (no charge yet). Support has a ticket open: https://support.example/t/INC-4523. We should avoid billing for the window if counts revert.
Priya: Action plan: 1) throttle proxy ingress to reduce duplicate surface (I've set nginx rate-limit to 100r/s per producer), 2) deploy emitter dedupe=true as a canary (10% traffic), 3) monitor token delta and alerts. Assignments: Priya (oncall), Jordan (SRE deploy), Alex (billing policy & customer comms), Maya (support comms).
Jordan: deploying canary now (deploy id: canary-20260318-09:18). command: `kubectl set env deploy/token-emitter DEDUPE=true -n billing --record` and rolling restart. Will route 10% via weight.
Jordan: canary metrics: within 3m, token delta for canary shards down to baseline (~2% variance). non-canary still noisy. starting 50% rollout.
Alex: recommend issuing a temporary credit for the window 09:10-09:22 and suppress automated overage emails until next notice. I'll draft the waiver and escalate to billing leads. :+1:
Maya: drafting customer message now, will post to support ticket and standby for approvals. ETA 12-15m.
Priya: rolling emitter to 100% now. throttles remain for 10 more minutes. Observability: counts returned to expected distribution across shards, no further duplicate warnings in logs.
OncallBot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring stable for 12m, alert rate back to baseline. NOTE: follow-up required: postmortem, default dedupe=true in emitter helm chart, and add a runbook step to check producer retry idempotency after deploys.
Alex: agree on postmortem + notify affected customers with credit. I'll coordinate with finance.
Maya: I'll send the customer note once billing confirms credit.
Priya: closing handoff to SRE & Billing for follow-up. thanks everyone. :pray:
OncallBot: auto-note created: INCIDENT-2026-03-18-1799998888, slack-thread archived.
